title: Pure Abyss Actor
summary: Abyss Actor cards only, with generic Rank 4s, Links and staples. Abyss Actors are Pendulum Fiends that Pendulum Summon in bulk. Each Abyss Script Spell does something small when played and something big when the opponent destroys it while it is Set, so the deck sets Scripts as bait. Abyss Actor - Superstar Sets a Script from the Deck every turn and stops Spell/Trap responses to its summon. Mellow Madonna searches an Abyss Actor Pendulum from the Scale. Abyss Playhouse - Fantastic Theater searches Scripts and turns their monster effects into "destroy a Set Spell/Trap". The 2023 cards lead. Abyss Actors' Dress Rehearsal searches an Abyss Actor and a Script at once. Liberty Dramatist jumps to their field in battle and fetches a Script. Abyss Actor - Super Producer places Fantastic Theater or a Pendulum on either Main Phase.
